gen-gf-lemonada-gf-kadwa: Kadwa is a text serif with a tall x-height and curves left open. Lemonada is best at loud, uniform-stroke display lines with wide-set spacing, while Kadwa does its best work in quiet, editorial running text.
gen-gf-lemonada-gf-slabo-13px: Lemonada draws tight, stylus-even lines with no thick downstrokes, giving headings a commanding hum. And Slabo 13px, a dignified serif with large open counters, keeps a long run of text easy on the eye.
gen-gf-libertinus-keyboard-gf-graduate: Towering lowercase letters lined up like pylons give Libertinus Keyboard its stance, with tight curls that pinch shut. But Graduate, a bookish text serif with generous spacing and joins as thick as its stems, lets the eye drift outward.
gen-gf-libertinus-math-gf-bhutuka-expand: BhuTuka Expanded One is a literary text serif with curvy letters and plain, constant-width lines that slow the reading to a stroll. Libertinus Math is bolder, with a soft felt-marker swell in its bowls.
gen-gf-libertinus-math-gf-hepta-slab: Expressive and bold, Libertinus Math swells like a worn felt marker. Hepta Slab then stretches each word out, with bent-wire strokes and open counters that make a long passage feel unhurried and dignified.
gen-gf-libertinus-math-gf-kiwi-maru: Libertinus Math has a worn felt-marker swell and gapped rounds. It excels at bold headlines, while Kiwi Maru, a traditional serif with generous letterspacing and an engraver's single-depth cut, excels at steady text.
gen-gf-libertinus-math-gf-stint-ultra-ex: Libertinus Math brings a visible, felt-marker swell to its bowls, a bold and expressive heading voice. And Stint Ultra Expanded, a classic serif with ruler-straight strokes, would feel too sprawling if the heading were made small.
gen-gf-libertinus-mono-gf-julius-sans-on: Julius Sans One reads like pencil lines drawn with big gaps of space between letters, light and open. And Libertinus Mono, with its tall, pen-nib bowls, gives that lightness a structured, precise spine.
gen-gf-libertinus-mono-gf-lexend-exa: Tall, pressed-flat letters meet a wide, sturdy body here, with Libertinus Mono's hanging s leading and Lexend Exa following. Their strongest quality is how closely related the strokes feel.
gen-gf-libertinus-mono-gf-lexend-giga: Lexend Giga is a sans-serif with flat, monoline strokes and generous tracking that opens up every word on the page. Libertinus Mono is best at structured headings with moderate modulation, while Giga keeps text smooth.
